emittedMessages.text: Mapped adapter resolution returned no instance.

trigger.condition: MappedStorageAdapter calls Resolve-MappedAdapter and its nonfailed registration resolver has no Result.

likelyCauses.text: MappedStorageAdapter calls Resolve-MappedAdapter and its nonfailed registration resolver has no Result.

diagnostics.action: Inspect registration identity and child Failure/HasResult flags, not registration payload.
diagnostics.expected: Redacted flags identify this source guard without content or provider effects.

correction.boundary: Diagnostic source-owner handoff only; no storage, vault, filesystem, REST or provider effect/retry.

steps.action: Record redacted registration owner handoff; stop before state repair or retry.
steps.expected: Owner handoff recorded; guard clearance not claimed.

stopWhen: Canonical mapped/concrete adapter and activity or exact message/pattern differs.
Effective Plan, storage address, graph, source file or provider owner cannot be established with redacted metadata.
Proposed action would expose bytes/secret/URL or execute read, write, delete, list, vault, REST, file or provider effects.

verification.action: Handoff identifies no-instance guard; instance resolution unresolved.

entries.redaction: Exclude Plan/ItemSignal, file/blob/secret paths and bytes, vault/storage address/URL, credentials, response/XML/JSON, graph, Conductor/Jacket and exception text; retain canonical adapter/activity, exact message/pattern and presence/type/guard flags only.
limitations: A source guard or Result presence does not establish a remote/file effect or safe retry.
